name: LibreDB Studio Self-Hosted SQL IDE
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted browser-based database IDE supporting SQL and NoSQL systems including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis and MongoDB; no vendor-imposed query or connection quota for the software.
watch_out: Run on your own machine, container or server; infrastructure and managed databases are not included. Protect the web interface and database credentials. Any optional external AI/model services or hosting may have separate terms and charges.
